# bioexcel/biobb_pmx/pmxmutate

## Summary

Wrapper class for the PMX mutate module.

Mutate residues in a protein structure.

Nextflow adapter of the [Pmxmutate](https://biobb-pmx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pmx.html#module-pmx.pmxmutate) building block of [biobb_pmx](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_pmx) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_PMX_PMXMUTATE } from 'bioexcel/biobb_pmx/pmxmutate'

workflow {
    BIOBB_PMX_PMXMUTATE(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_structure_path` | yes | pdb, gro | Path to the input structure file |
| `input_b_structure_path` | no | pdb, gro | Path to the mutated input structure file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_structure_path` | yes | pdb, gro | Path to the output structure file |
| `versions_biobb_pmx` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_pmx', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Pmxmutate properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_structure_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_pmx container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_PMX_PMXMUTATE' {
        ext.properties = [mutation_list: '2Ala']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mutation_list` | string | "2Ala" | Mutation list in the format "Chain:Resnum MUT_AA_Code" or "Chain:Resnum MUT_NA_Code" (no spaces between the elements) separated by commas. If no chain is provided as chain code all the chains in the pdb file will be mutated. ie: "A:15CYS". Possible MUT_AA_Code: 'ALA', 'ARG', 'ASN', 'ASP', 'ASPH', 'ASPP', 'ASH', 'CYS', 'CYS2', 'CYN', 'CYX', 'CYM', 'CYSH', 'GLU', 'GLUH', 'GLUP', 'GLH', 'GLN', 'GLY', 'HIS', 'HIE', 'HISE', 'HSE', 'HIP', 'HSP', 'HISH', 'HID', 'HSD', 'ILE', 'LEU', 'LYS', 'LYSH', 'LYP', 'LYN', 'LSN', 'MET', 'PHE', 'PRO', 'SER', 'SP1', 'SP2', 'THR', 'TRP', 'TYR', 'VAL'. Possible MUT_NA_Codes: 'A', 'T', 'C', 'G', 'U'. |
| `force_field` | string | "amber99sb-star-ildn-mut" | Forcefield to use. |
| `resinfo` | boolean | false | Show the list of 3-letter -> 1-letter residues. |
| `gmx_lib` | string | "$CONDA_PREFIX/lib/python3.7/site-packages/pmx/data/mutff/" | Path to the GMXLIB folder in your computer. |
| `binary_path` | string | "pmx" | Path to the PMX command line interface. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
